name: Toepick
abilities: Nightmarish face - opening his cage helmet reveals an eldritch face that taps primal fears, driving almost any being to terror, insanity or nausea (even Celestialsapien personalities)
Fear works even second-hand: photographs of his face come out blurry but still unsettle viewers
Containment helmet is extremely difficult to damage
Enhanced strength - can lift a car
Immune to nightmarish sights (multiphasic eyesight filters out unknowable horrors), so he can look at himself and his own kind
weaknesses: Some beings are unaffected: Ma Vreedle ('seen worse'), Dagon, and Professor Paradox (who can perceive the face clearly)
One-trick alien - the face is his only real weapon and it does nothing to the blind
summary: A hulking greenish-yellow ogre with a locked cage on his head; open the cage and whatever is inside scares nearly anything in the universe into submission.
traits: Ben's scariest alien and his second-least favourite (after The Worst)
First mentioned in the OS episode Ken 10 - Ken refused to use him and swapped him for Grey Matter
Face inspired by H.P. Lovecraft; design inspired by an Autry Museum art piece
Screams, wails, hisses and demonic laughter play whenever the cage opens
Replaced Way Big in the OV intro from Arc 4 onward
notableFeats: Terrified a Dwarf Star-powered Psyphon into begging (Special Delivery)
Scared Zombozo into wrecking his own machine, freeing the zombie clowns (Something Zombozo This Way Comes)
Frightened Psyphon and Argit so badly Argit vomited up the dehydrated Techadon Army Cube (Cough It Up)

appearances.designNotes: Greenish-yellow ogre with long misshapen spiky arms and pointy fingers, black briefs with a metal green waistband, chains linking waist and chest armour, dark-green metal cage helmet with two horns and a toenail-shaped crest through whose bars glowing green eyes show; Omnitrix symbol on the helmet's chest extension.

image.label: OV
image.notes: Infobox render (432x585, transparent, helmet closed). 'Toepick Face Model.png' shows the tentacled face model made for Bandai.

scoring.rationale: Special 7: the fear face ended fights against a Dwarf-Star-powered Psyphon and Zombozo instantly and works on almost anything, Celestialsapiens included. Everything else is weak - slow, ordinary strength, poor eyesight, no other attacks - and a handful of beings simply shrug the face off.

notes: OS: only mentioned by Ben 10,000 in Ken 10 as an alien in Ken's replica Omnitrix - never transformed into, so no OS appearance despite the wiki category 'Ben 10,000's Transformations'.
Never locked in the Omnitrix; Ben already knew how to use him in Special Delivery (Derrick J. Wyatt).
Ben 23's 'Fright Face' was revealed by Derrick after the show and is treated as non-canon by the wiki. A hypothetical Ultimate Toepick would radiate fear.
Special Delivery use is non-speaking; Something Zombozo This Way Comes was an unintentional transformation.
